reviews.t: I love this LED Bluetooth Vanity Mirror!
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:862a35239afab49a4eff9210c01d25bc]] This is a really neat gift I recieved! Putting on makeup will never be the same! It makes me feel great about myself!

reviews.t: Works well and has for nearly a year and still working
reviews.x: Bought for my teenage daughter as a birthday gift. She LOVES it. Does her makeup and is also able to listen to her music at the same time. What else could a girl want, right???

I use this mirror so much more than just for its mirror lol .. It started by just having it next to the couch bc I was doing my eyebrows and idk about anyone else but with kids it is a very long process that doesnt get done in one sitting lol.  My fav part is it was next to me when I couldn't turn the lamp on  bc way too bright and randomly tried out the lights on mirror ... it has become a very useful reading light and it's very nice having speakers up behind my head and not on my lap with a li
Super cute. My daughter just recently got into playing with makeup so I bought her this. The lights could be brighter but its still super cute. Love that music can be played on this as well.
Gift for my niece and she is happy till this day! She loves it, specially the Bluetooth feature!!
It's a great mirror, the light isn't super bright. But it works well enough. The sound is basic
It's ok, but the speaker buzzes no matter how low the volume. Not worth 40.00

reviews.t: Not as bright as I would like
reviews.x: It's a great concept, but the mirror doesn't get as bright as I'd like. I bought a few of these as gifts, but I'm not sure if I'll give them out.
Good gift if you dont know what to get a girl in your family. Has bluetooth and is flashy. Looks expensive so you will look good. bbb
Only thing is When I use my Bluetooth is an weird sound coming from my end to my callers

It does everything it says it does. Bluetooth is basically clear & speakers are loud. Lights work fine. Tilts & swivels. Now, it is obviously on the "less expensive" side. The base is plastic & sort of flimsy. Bluetooth paired with no problem but the sound is lacking a bit. The lights are also lacking considerably. It does come with a detachable magnifying mirror. Has a charger, instructional guide, & cloth for wiping smudges. Overall, you CANNOT beat this mirror & it's functionalities for the p

reviews.t: Perfect vanity mirror for an awesome price
reviews.x: I am obsessed with my Bluetooth vanity mirror!! Super happy I finally decided to order one of these! & I picked the perfect one!! I connect my iPhone while I’m getting ready & WOW, I’m impressed with the sound quality. It’s pretty loud! I love that the mirror can swivel up & down. I haven’t had to charge my mirror yet & I use it daily! The brightness of the lights is perfect and you can adjust the brightness which is a PLUS. Purchase this beautiful mirror. You will not regret it.

This product was very cheaply made for the price. The plastic is cheap and felt as if it was going to break when I put the item together. The USB port fell inside mirror when I connected it, it still worked but did not fit right. Also the light was not adjustable like description. It stayed one brightness which was very dim and not suitable to use as a make up light. Overall I was very disappointed in this product!

Love this mirror ! Lights are bright and won’t flush your skin-tone out , mirror is super clear ! Lights are adjustable to your needs , perfect size for your vanity, very portable. Battery life is amazing , plus it’s rechargeable , easy to clean and manage. Speakers are clear and it has volume control for your own needs. Last a really long time , great quality product

I love the rose gold color. Overall, it’s a great product for gift or persona use. I wish the lights were a lot brighter but it’s manageable. Also not a big fan of the material of the mirror. Wish it wasn’t made out of plastic lets see how long this lasts me. Bluetooth/phone call is awesome probably my favorite part of this whole thing

It is a really good product but I was waiting more brightness and more options to change the lighting. It also goes down really quick. I turned it on for my makeup routine and turned it off, at night I wanted to turn it on to take off my makeup and I had to charge it because it wouldn’t turn on.

I am giving this mirror 5 stars as I just opened it, checked the light function and brightness, and connected to the Bluetooth. So far, so good! The mirror is a great size, pretty color (rose gold), and it is lightweight. I will update if I have any issues, but upon first look, I am impressed.

I like this mirror as a mirror, I use it every day to do my makeup but the lights on it barely do anything and it dies pretty quickly when you do use them. It's a bit bigger than your typical mirror so I like it for that reason but other than that it is just ok.

I love the mirror. It is very cute and I like the brightness in it. The Bluetooth works well, and i love how I can hear my music while doing my makeup. The lights could be brighter instead it’s not too bright. My daughter even loves it too and she’s 2.

reviews.t: It's okay mirror,  but Bluetooth does not work!
reviews.x: I am giving it 2 stars, because the mirror is nice, but the features I bought it for do not work.  The Bluetooth never would connect. Have to keep it plugged in mostly,  would not keep a charge for long periods of time.

Not a huge fan of this mirror. I wasn’t expecting perfection with the sound quality, but I wasn’t expecting it to be staticky. The lights also aren’t super bright. Probably better for a kid/tween than an adult.

reviews.t: Great mirror for good price, just not super bright.
reviews.x: This mirror works amazing! Very light weight and easy to travel with. The lights aren’t super bright though. If you’re in a darker room, I’m sure they’d work just fine. This was a great purchase for the price!

I bought this mirror and I loved it but the stand came broken. I returned it the same day I got it and I'm getting a replacement tomorrow, I hope the stand comes intact because I'm super excited to use it.

Light brightness even at maximum is not enough for me. Also light is bright white not warm yellow as i thought. Light weighted good for travel Im not returning bcz i broke the small magnifying mirror.

reviews.t: A MUST HAVE! Amazed at the quality for the price!!
reviews.x: Love!! I'm a music fanatic,, speaker is amazing! Just a very convenient, light, pretty mirror!! Just ordered one for my daughter for Valentine's Day!! Definitely worth every small cent spent!

claims.text: Many reviewers love the Bluetooth feature and enjoy playing music through the mirror while getting ready.
Several reviewers find the lights not as bright as they would like.
It is frequently praised as a great gift for daughters, nieces, or girls in the family.
Some reviewers criticize the build quality, noting cheap or flimsy plastic for the price.
A few reviewers report speaker issues such as buzzing or odd sounds during calls.
